$ go test  # pkg-a
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
PASS
$ go test ./b  # pkg-b
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/shout
PASS
$ edit testdata/script/twice.txtar  # edit b's section by hand, and change what echo prints
$ go test ./b  # pkg-b
    script/twice: A1 is twice B1. The root package, ., prints it with echo, and ./b with shout.
        shout: Does what the case's shout/ tree says.
        out/shout/values.txt differs (-golden +got):
        - A1 SIX?
        + A1 SIX
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice/shout
FAIL
[exit 1]
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # pkg-a
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
PASS
